notes.title: Ecliptica pre alpha release teaser
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="MtVmoGXsACA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Welcome to the procedurally generated, dense, infinitely vast, and [b]stylized[/b] world of [b]Ecliptica[/b].[/p][p]You are one of the colonists on an alien planet, fighting for the survival of both your colony and yourself. In this world, you can:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mine:[/b] All resources in the game are extracted, processed, and created in your colony's factories; nothing appears out of nowhere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trade:[/b] All prices for all goods are regulated solely by a free market, without any restrictions – whether it's food or high-tech power cells.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manage:[/b] Every worker wants to become a manager: more power means more money. But if that's not enough, you can create your own corporation and bring the entire colony under your control.[/p][/*][/list]
